stem: Four points are graphed on the coordinate grid. Point Z will be located at \(\left(-3\frac{1}{2},3\right)\). Which point best represents a location that is \(3\frac{1}{2}\) units away from point Z?
visual_elements: coordinate grid with points T at (-7, 3), X at (-5, 6), R at (-3, 2), M at (1, 3)
